_README: Group 3 Source Evidence Pack for the observation ACTUALLY EMITTED to and ACCEPTED by Group 1 on 2026-08-25. Built from the emitted observation and Group 1's own acceptance response - NOT from a fresh call to the source. A fresh call would return a different value and a different hash.
_supersedes: The 07:27Z re-queried pack, which described a DIFFERENT retrieval (artifact 4587cccde44b49ed) than the one Group 1 accepted.
_observation_id_note: AUTHORITATIVE, not provisional. Group 1 preserved it verbatim through POST and GET - acceptance check 4.

group1_acceptance._trace_note: trace_id is minted PER REQUEST, not per observation. It is not a correlation key. observation_id is.

raw_artifact._gap: GAP - the response BYTES for this capture were not written to disk at capture time, so this sha256 cannot be independently recomputed. The hash is what Group 3 computed over the actual bytes received and is what Group 1 holds, but it is not third-party verifiable for THIS capture. build_live_observation_candidate.py now persists the bytes, so every capture from this point forward is verifiable. Stated, not hidden.

source_model_grid_cell._role: SOURCE-RESPONSE METADATA - not the canonical observation location.
source_model_grid_cell._what_it_is: Open-Meteo snaps a request to its nearest model grid cell and returns that cell's coordinates and elevation in the response body. This is the cell the 0.1 mm value was actually computed for.
source_model_grid_cell._must_not: Must not replace the Group 1 canonical coordinates, and must not be presented as where the observation was taken.
source_model_grid_cell._verified: Confirmed 2026-08-25 by re-calling the endpoint with the same requested coordinates and comparing the returned latitude/longitude/elevation.

device_sensor_identity._note: G3-EXT-OPENMETEO-01 is a Group 3 EXTERNAL-PROVIDER identifier under the approved G3-EXT-<PROVIDER>-<NN> convention. It is NOT a physical device. flight_id EXT asserts that NO flight occurred. No Group 3 sensor was involved and none is claimed.

measurement._note: Value and unit both taken from the source response. Never invented.

field_applicability._why: Distinguishes STRUCTURALLY_NOT_APPLICABLE from DATA_GAP for this capture_method. Consume this to render honestly; do not infer either meaning from the NOT_VERIFIED token alone.

STRUCTURALLY_NOT_APPLICABLE.location.gnss_status: Value on the wire is NOT_VERIFIED. There is no GNSS receiver in this path at all - a weather API has no positioning system. This is not an unverified fix; it is the absence of the concept.
STRUCTURALLY_NOT_APPLICABLE.location.position_accuracy_m: Value on the wire is null. Same reason - no positioning system exists to report an accuracy for.
STRUCTURALLY_NOT_APPLICABLE.calibration_state: Value on the wire is NOT_VERIFIED. A numerical weather model is not a calibrated instrument; there is no calibration procedure that could apply to it.

GENUINE_DATA_GAP.accuracy: Value on the wire is NOT_VERIFIED. This field DOES apply - a source can publish per-value uncertainty - but this Open-Meteo endpoint does not return one, and Group 3 will not estimate it. Applicable, unknown.

CORRECT_AS_STATED.hardware_verified: false. Not a gap and not inapplicable - it is a true negative. No Group 3 hardware was involved.

field_applicability._ui_guidance: Render STRUCTURALLY_NOT_APPLICABLE as 'not applicable' or omit the row. Render GENUINE_DATA_GAP as 'not reported by source'. Rendering both as 'NOT VERIFIED' tells a viewer a sensor failed when no sensor exists.

evidence_classification.explanation: EXTERNAL LIVE API - numerical weather model output, updated continuously
evidence_classification._honesty: Real external third-party data carried through the controlled Group 3 runtime path. NOT physical Group 3 hardware evidence. accuracy NOT_VERIFIED, calibration_state NOT_VERIFIED, hardware_verified false. No Group 3 sensor has produced a recorded reading.
